Welcome to Sourced By JH.

We're a UK-based luxury sourcing and personal shopping service. Designer fashion, bags, watches, jewellery, streetwear and sneakers, found for you through our trusted supplier network.

Two ways to buy:
· Pieces posted on this page are available to source now
· Not on the page? Tell us what you want and we'll find it

Every item is checked before it reaches you, and you deal with one person from first message to delivery. No bots, no automated replies.

DM, WhatsApp us, or request through the link in bio.
